limitations: Known bath T>0, exact symmetric cusp-well with a,b>0, unbiased orientation switching, limit v to zero before tumbling rate asymptotics. The inverse result assumes exact data, not stability to finite measurement error. Frydel 2022 full text was inaccessible and general Kubo inverse theory presents residual originality risk.
scientific_integrity: Stationary full-state weak-propulsion EPR coefficient; nonequilibrium current normalization and all orders of limits are fixed. Every claim is reconstructed analytically. Standalone finite-grid checks are illustrative only.
title: Inverse entropy-production spectroscopy of a bistable run-and-tumble particle
